status: DRAFT, for engineering; spec clauses remain the authority

reading.role: AccessKit Role name, checked against accesskit 0.25.2. Pinned version UNVERIFIED: GraphicsObject and some others may need a Group fallback.
reading.style: An id under design-system.json state.interaction. Every state not listed here comes from it, focus included.
reading.size: Logical px at scale 1. Density modes change only what design-system.json density says.
reading.author_id: Grammar of STU-MDL-100. Never position, never index, never locale text. stable_id derives mechanically (STU-MDL-103).
reading.owner: Kumihimo owns the control mechanic and its pure-Vulkan renderer (STU-ARC-023, D8). Where it lives between Kumihimo and hsk-studio-controls is open decision O5. Each record here is the theme and behaviour input, not a new asset.

universal_rules: Every interactive control takes a UiDescriptor generated id; no literal strings in tooltip or accessible APIs (STU-SHL-245).
Every control shows hover, active, focus and disabled, and every disabled control exposes its reason (STU-SHL-019).
Focus is always a 2px ring, or an inset ring on a row or tab, in focus.ring with focus.halo. It is shown on keyboard focus only, never removed, and never clipped.
Hover states never fire while a widget owns the pointer (STU-SHL-104).
A press claims at press; panel and tab drags start only from designated chrome (STU-SHL-101, 102).
All on-screen commands have a menu leaf; context menus and rails are projections (STU-SHL-013, 014).
A status is never carried by colour alone.
Every region, panel, tool, Layout Preset and control has a generated manual entry resolved by its author_id, in the same change as its behaviour (STU-MAN-102, STU-SHL-139).

keyboard.status: Default chords are PROVISIONAL until SHL-P-16 (STU-SHL-045, 131). Navigation keys below are not document commands. Every chord is a shortcut_id, resolved at render.
keyboard.region_cycle: F6 moves focus forward through Tool Rail, Browse Dock, Viewport, Inspect Dock, Time and Results Dock, Context Bar, status bar. Shift+F6 goes back. A collapsed edge is one stop: its rail.
keyboard.inside_region: Tab and Shift+Tab move between controls in reading order. Arrow keys move inside composite controls such as rails, tabs, trees and menus, with one roving tab stop per composite.
keyboard.escape: Closes the topmost popup; aborts an owned gesture restoring the pre-press value; exits text edit. Escape never closes a Task Scope silently.
keyboard.help: F1 on the focused control opens its manual anchor in the side sheet (STU-SHL-230).
keyboard.palette: Ctrl+K opens the search and command surface, PROVISIONAL.
keyboard.focus_never_stolen: Agent activity, job completion and receipts never move focus (STU-QUIET-003).
